description_en: Restarts an HBase cluster by calling RestartInstance
kebab_example: aliyun hbase restart-instance --cluster-id ld-bp150tns0sjxs0000 --components THRIFT --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestartInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of target instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html to obtain target instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the component in the target instance. Valid values:

- **HBASE**
- **HADOOP**
- **PHOENIX**
- **SOLR**
- **THRIFT**
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的组件名称，取值：

- **HBASE**
- **HADOOP**
- **PHOENIX**
- **SOLR**
- **THRIFT**
parameters.name: components
